_comment: Example of ONE song file in the growing song-library/ folder. Real songs live one-per-file here as <slug>.json and are gitignored (this _example.json is the only committed one). Add songs with: pptx_deck_builder.py song add --file entry.json, or backfill from an existing deck with: song import-deck --deck week.pptx. Text below is an original placeholder -- put your church's own licensed/typed lyrics here, never lyrics copied from a generic lyrics-aggregator website. Repeat markers like //..// and ///../// are shown on screen literally (a cue to sing the phrase 2x / 3x), so keep them in the text.
